page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.cm4.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 12 dedicated physical cores and 12 vCPUs, utilizing an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running at 3.2 GHz. The CPU configuration includes 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 33 MB L3 cache, with support for AVX-512 and vector neural network instructions. It is equipped with 48.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core, but does not include local storage or GPU hardware.

Performance benchmarks position this instance in the average range for most compute and memory tasks. Single-core stress-ng performance registers at 1575.58, while multi-core performance reaches 12474.34. Memory read-only bandwidth is measured at 698.22 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 55.6 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. However, the system exhibits weaker performance in specific areas, such as the Passmark physics test and the Passmark memory score, which fall into the bottom 25% tier.

For specialized workloads, the instance achieves 11.64 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks and a static web serving throughput of 7.8 GB/sec. Large language model inference speeds are moderate for small models, processing 755.34 tokens per second for prompts, but drop significantly to 17.38 tokens per second under a medium 7B model. This hardware profile is qualitatively cost-efficient for general-purpose workloads, software compilation, and database operations that require dedicated CPU allocation without the overhead of local storage or GPU accelerators.
